decisions.title: 2 · Poem excerpts
decisions.notes:
I agree with the key extract; we are good there. I think we should fix the area excerpts so the layout doesn't look zigzag. This will ensure the poem is read in the same alignment vertically. 

The language heading is already in small letters; we can use the Mankada Pathara color for that.

decisions.title: 3 · Poet presence
decisions.notes:
We can use ... instead of wrapping the line beyond the fixed space allocated for the quote.

Also, can we put the poet's picture on the left and the heading of the poem and the name of the author on the right? I wanted to see a few variations on that.

decisions.title: 4 · Recent editions
decisions.notes: The story behind the cover can be in the edition page. in the heading "cover image story" or something like that.
